answer: The horizon is the register of identities, and it re-leases its fixed relay slots each epoch, one identity per slot. A lease burns zenith, minted only from honest work, at a toll set by how many identities bid against those slots. A crystal is one fake identity, so a fleet of a thousand drives the toll up a thousandfold and the bill outruns the headcount. Slots are exclusive, so a clone cannot share one, and the toll follows the field, not the owner, so splitting buys nothing. It breaks if the horizon adds slots or sells leases on.
